instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts Outfit and Plus Jakarta Sans into public/index.html or index.css.
Implement game context state switching seamlessly between SuperEnalotto, VinciCasa, and 10eLotto.
Render realistic 3D tactile lottery balls with gradients, shadows, and smooth hover animations.
Ensure backend API sync state is reflected with live spinners, error messages, and success toasts using sonner.
Add interactive generator with instant coupon visualization that can be saved or copied.
Ensure full responsiveness from 320px mobile screens to large desktop monitors.
Every clickable button, dropdown, chart, and status indicator must carry explicit data-testid attributes.
